items.originalTitle: McLaren opens its vault to sell five extraordinary Formula 1 cars
items.summaryEn: McLaren is selling five Formula 1 cars from its vast heritage collection, including two from Ayrton Senna's final title-winning season and the car Brad Pitt drove during filming of the F1 movie. The cars will be sold through specialist dealer Tom Hartley Jnr.
detailZh: 迈凯伦将出售五辆经典F1赛车
迈凯伦正在出售其经典车收藏中的五辆历史性F1赛车，包括两辆塞纳时代的赛车，以及布拉德·皮特拍摄电影《F1》时驾驶的赛车。
致迈凯伦车迷。来自沃金的木瓜色新闻，带来车手、赛车、车队策略以及每个比赛周末的最新消息。
迈凯伦从其丰富的经典车收藏中出售五辆F1赛车，包括两辆来自塞纳最后一个夺冠赛季的赛车，以及布拉德·皮特拍摄这部成功F1电影时驾驶的赛车。
这些赛车将通过专业经销商Tom Hartley Jnr出售——正是这家机构此前售出了伯尼·埃克莱斯顿的一级方程式赛车收藏——而在此之前，这些赛车一直归迈凯伦所有。
两辆1991年的迈凯伦MP4/6A（底盘04和07），来自塞纳赢得他第三个也是最后一个世界冠军的那一年。两辆车都曾由塞纳测试，并由队友格哈德·伯格驾驶参赛。
2012年的MP4/27A（底盘01），来自刘易斯·汉密尔顿效力该车队的最后一个赛季。2012年，简森·巴顿赢了三场比赛，而汉密尔顿赢了四场。
2021年的MCL35M（底盘01），兰多·诺里斯曾驾驶它在摩纳哥以一次性海湾石油涂装获得第三名。同年晚些时候，这辆车参与了迈凯伦在蒙扎的1-2名完赛，当时丹尼尔·里卡多击败诺里斯，为车队赢得了自2012年以来的首场胜利。
2023 年的 MCL37A（底盘 03），由诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里驾驶参赛。影片拍摄期间，皮特驾驶它绕行美洲赛道。
据哈特利介绍，2023 年的 MCL37A 是迈凯伦有史以来向私人买家提供的最新一款曾参加比赛的 F1 赛车。
迈凯伦赛车首席执行官扎克·布朗表示：“我们决定出售这些标志性的迈凯伦一级方程式赛车，因为我们认为让它们仅仅闲置在仓库里，是对它们所代表意义的一种辜负。”
“这些赛车生来就是为了被驾驶和竞速的，我们希望看到它们被使用、被享受。我们相信，这是让我们的历史保持鲜活、让我们的经典车业务保持活力的最佳方式。”
目前还没有价格消息，但有报道估计总价值在2500万至5000万美元之间。与埃克莱斯顿收藏被单一买家整体收购不同，这些赛车可能被单独出售。
哈特利在一份声明中表示：“当然，这里也完全有可能发生同样的情况。不过，这五辆车将单独出售，而且没有任何时间压力。我们的首要任务，也是迈凯伦的首要任务，是为它们找到合适的归宿。”
这些赛车将由迈凯伦进行整备，然后才交付给新车主。
detailEn: McLaren opens its vault to sell five extraordinary Formula 1 cars
McLaren is selling five historic Formula 1 cars from its heritage collection, including two Ayrton Senna-era machines and the car driven by Brad Pitt during filming of "F1"
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.

From its vast heritage collection, McLaren is selling five Formula 1 cars, including two from Ayrton Senna's final title-winning season and the car that Brad Pitt drove during the filming of the successful F1 movie.

The cars will be sold through specialist dealer Tom Hartley Jnr - the same organisation that sold Bernie Ecclestone’s grand prix collection of cars - with them being under the ownership of McLaren up until this point.
Two 1991 McLaren MP4/6As (chassis 04 and 07), from the year Senna won his third and final world title. Both were tested by Senna and raced by team-mate Gerhard Berger.
The 2012 MP4/27A (chassis 01), from Lewis Hamilton’s final season with the team. Jenson Button won three races in 2012, while Hamilton won four.

The 2021 MCL35M (chassis 01), which Lando Norris drove to third in Monaco in a one-off Gulf livery. The car was part of McLaren’s 1-2 at Monza later that year, when Daniel Ricciardo beat Norris to the team’s first win since 2012.
The 2023 MCL37A (chassis 03), raced by Norris and Oscar Piastri. Pitt took it round the Circuit of the Americas while the film was being shot.
The 2023 MCL37A is the newest race-driven McLaren F1 car ever offered to a private buyer, according to Hartley.

“We have decided to part with these iconic McLaren Formula 1 cars because we feel that having them simply sitting in storage is a disservice to what they represent,” McLaren Racing CEO Zak Brown said.
“These cars were built to be driven and raced, and we want to see them being used and enjoyed. We believe that is the best way to keep our history alive and our heritage business active.”

There's no word of a price yet, but there are reports that estimate a combined value of somewhere between £25 to $50million. Unlike the Ecclestone collection, which was sold to just one buyer, these cars could be sold individually.

“There is of course every possibility that the same could happen here. However, these five cars will be offered individually and there is no time pressure whatsoever,” Hartley said in a statement. “Our priority, and McLaren’s, is to find the right homes for them.”
The cars will be prepared by McLaren before they are handed over to their new owners.
keyPointsZh: 这些赛车通过专业经销商Tom Hartley Jnr出售，该机构也曾出售伯尼·埃克莱斯顿的大奖赛赛车收藏。
keyPointsEn: The cars are being sold through specialist dealer Tom Hartley Jnr, the same organisation that sold Bernie Ecclestone's grand prix car collection.

items.originalTitle: Martin Brundle unveils incredible 860hp Porsche 911 creation with daughter Charlie
detailZh: 马丁·布伦德尔与女儿查理共同揭晓860马力保时捷911改装车
前F1车手马丁·布伦德尔与女儿查理和加州公司Gunther Werks联手，打造了一款独家860马力的保时捷911改装车
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计以及那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
前F1车手和天空体育解说员马丁·布伦德尔与女儿查理合作，联手加州公司Gunther Werks打造了一款860马力的空冷运动跑车——这是一款非常特别的机器
The Brundle Edition Turbo 是基于 Gunther Werks 改装的保时捷 911 Turbo，总共只会建造五辆。
查理·布伦德尔，一位车手，他的简历包括在迈凯轮、阿斯顿·马丁和捷豹路虎等制造商的工作经历，领导了这个项目的造型设计。马丁凭借他在各种赛车驾驶方面的几乎无限经验，帮助开发了它的驾驶性能，包括其运动和赛道设置。
“与 Gunther Werks 合作，并且让我的女儿领导设计，意味着这个项目对我来说非常个人化，”布伦德尔在公告中表示。“我们将我们从驾驶座、维修区和设计工作室的集体经验都倾注到了这辆车上。”
后置的 4.0 升双涡轮增压水平六缸发动机产生了惊人的 860 马力和 610 磅英尺的扭矩。考虑到汽车纯粹主义者，它仅配备六速手动变速箱，将动力传递到后轮。
尽管有这些数据，布伦德尔坚持认为这仍然是一辆你可以在公共道路上享受的车。
“对我来说， Gunther Werks 车辆最独特的地方之一是，尽管它拥有极端的赛车性能，但它却非常文明且易于使用，”他说。
除了其惊人的性能外，它还配备了可调节的后翼、前翼尖、碳陶瓷布雷博刹车和带有布伦德尔标志的锻造镁合金轮毂。它还采用了赛车手头盔启发的双色珍珠漆，引擎盖上带有“Brundle”徽标。
车内，头枕上带有由查理本人设计的“MB”纹章，仪表板的末端由他自己签名。仪表盘还带有英国车迷会认出的标语：“汽车最重要的部分是固定方向盘的螺母。”
买家还将收到一顶与赛车同色系的Bell HP77头盔，由布伦德尔签名并经过赛车使用认证。
这辆车将在拉斯维加斯的温尼康克赛会上向公众展示。希望我们能在接近时间时得知价格和其他性能细节。
detailEn: Martin Brundle unveils incredible 860hp Porsche 911 creation with daughter Charlie
Former F1 driver Martin Brundle has joined forces with his daughter Charlie and Gunther Werks to create an exclusive 860hp Porsche 911 restomod
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Former F1 driver and Sky Sports commentator Martin Brundle has teamed up with his daughter Charlie on an 860hp air-cooled sports car, built by Californian company Gunther Werks - and it's a pretty special machine.
The Brundle Edition Turbo is based on Gunther Werks’ reworked Porsche 911 Turbo, and only five will ever be built.

Charlie Brundle, a car designer whose CV includes stints at manufacturers such as McLaren, Aston Martin and Jaguar Land Rover, led the design aspect of the project. Martin, using his almost infinite experience behind the wheel of all sorts of motor vehicles, helped develop how it drives, including its Sport and Track settings.

“To collaborate with Gunther Werks and to have my daughter lead the design means this project is deeply personal,” Brundle said in the announcement. “We’ve poured our collective experience from the driver’s seat, the paddock and the design studios into this car.”

A rear-mounted 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged flat-six produces an astonishing 860hp and 610lb-ft of torque. And with automotive purists in mind, it only comes with a six-speed manual gearbox that sends power to the rear wheels.
Despite those figures, Brundle insists it's still a car you can enjoy on the public road.
“For me, one of the most unique aspects of a Gunther Werks vehicle is that, despite having extreme race car performance, it is remarkably civilised and usable too,” he said.

On top of its blistering performance, it also gets an adjustable rear wing, front canards, carbon ceramic Brembo brakes and forged magnesium wheels with the Brundle branding. It also gets two-tone pearl paint inspired by the racing driver's helmet, with "Brundle" badging on the engine cover.

Inside, the headrests carry an "MB" monogram designed by Charlie herself, and the endplates of the dash are signed by the man himself. The dashboard also carries a line that fans of the Briton will recognise: “The most important bit of the car is the nut holding the steering wheel.”
Buyers will also receive a Bell HP77 helmet painted in the same colour scheme, signed by Brundle and certified for race use.
The car will be shown to the public at the Concours at Wynn Las Vegas. Hopefully we find out the price and other performance specifics closer to the time.

items.originalTitle: Esteban Ocon responds to Haas signing Rafael Camara for F1 2027
detailZh: 埃斯蒂班·奥康回应哈斯车队签下拉斐尔·卡马拉参加2027年F1赛事
埃斯蒂班·奥康将在2027年被法拉利青训车队车手拉斐尔·卡马拉取代，并且明年没有真正的F1赛车手位置选择
埃斯蒂班·奥康认为他的哈斯车队替代者拉斐尔·卡马拉应该得到在F1中展示自己的机会，但他觉得不应该没有2027年的赛车手位置
卡马拉的签约在上周得到确认，作为巴西人从F2联赛晋升而来——他目前是联赛的领导者。尽管奥利弗·贝尔曼尚未被哈斯车队官方宣布留队，但美国车队希望延长他的合同。
在2027年的赛车上没有留下任何真正的机会，除非出现任何惊喜的退出，奥康的选择非常有限，这位30岁的车手最有可能签订一份预备合同来保持他的竞技状态——而不是转战其他类别。
奥康坚称他的表现并不是他离开的原因，但再次不愿透露哈斯车队选择不续约的具体原因。
“我无法说太多。我可以说的是，拉法应该得到一次F1的机会。我认为他在其他类别中已经证明了自己非常出色，”他在本周末的美国大奖赛之前说。
“但我不应该同时被排除在F1之外。就是这样。我来到这里是为了尽我所能做好工作，试图最大限度地发挥汽车的性能。”
“正如我所说，我有资格在这里参加一级方程式赛车。有很多原因说明我明年不会在这里，但它们不是性能原因。我在每个类别中都赢得了所有的一切。”
拉斐尔·卡马拉将加入哈斯一级方程式车队参加2027赛季
“我在卡丁车、雷诺方程式、三级方程式、GP3、F1等所有这些类别中都赢得了比赛。仅从体育角度考虑，我有资格参加F1。我相信这不会是我F1生涯的最后一年。”
奥康的焦点是确保他能在哈斯车队的最后几场比赛中继续表现出色，并帮助车队在 制造商锦标赛中保持第七名的位置 - 目前领先奥迪七分。
尽管他在得知自己2026年没有赛车后得到了公众的支持，奥康表示他并不需要来自同行的私人支持——而且事实上也没有收到过。
"当然，我在私底下会和一些家伙聊天，"这位法国人补充道。"比如，兰斯来找我谈过。但我没有收到任何人的消息。
"他们没有给我发短信——在媒体上表示支持。这没关系。毕竟，这并不是终点。我不需要任何车手或什么的支持。那不是我所需要的。对每个人来说，这是一个艰难的世界。
"我们都在经历同样的事情。如果你在三场比赛中表现不佳，你就是最差的。如果你在三场好比赛中表现良好，你就是最好的。所以，这就是这项运动的困难所在。"
detailEn: Esteban Ocon responds to Haas signing Rafael Camara for F1 2027
Esteban Ocon is being replaced by Ferrari junior Rafael Camara for 2027 and has no real options for an F1 drive next year
Esteban Ocon agrees that his Haas replacement Rafael Camara deserves his chance to be in Formula 1, but feels he does not deserve to be without a seat for 2027.

Camara's signing was confirmed last week as the Brazilian steps up from F2 - where he is currently the championship leader. Although Oliver Bearman is yet to be officially announced by Haas as staying at the team, the American outfit is hoping to extend his deal.

With no real opportunities left on the 2027 grid barring any surprise exits, Ocon's options are slim and the 30-year-old is most likely looking at a reserve deal to keep his hand in - rather than making a switch to a different category.
Ocon was adamant that his performances were not the reason for his departure, but once more would not be drawn on the specific reasons why Haas chose not to extend his deal.
"I can't say very much. What I will say is that Rafa deserves a shot in F1. I think he's shown in the categories that he's very good," he said ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix.
"But I don't deserve to be out of F1 at the same time. That's it. I'm coming here to do the best job I can, trying to exploit the maximum out of the car.
"As I said, I deserve to be here in Formula 1. There are many circumstances why I'm not here next year. But they are not the performance reasons. I've won everything in every category.
Rafael Camara joins Haas F1 Team for 2027

"I've done in go-karts, in Formula Renault, in Formula 3, in GP3, in F1. In all these categories I've won races. Just thinking from a sports perspective, I deserve to be in F1. I believe that this is not my last year in F1."

Ocon's focus, then, was on ensuring that he could continue to deliver in his final races for Haas and assist the team in its fight to retain seventh in the constructors' championship - it is currently seven points clear of Audi.
Although he'd received public support following the news that he was out of a drive for 2026, Ocon stated that he didn't need private support from his fellow drivers - and nor had he received anyway.
"Of course I talk to some of the guys in private life," the Frenchman added. "Lance came to speak to me for example. But I didn't receive any messages from anyone.

"They haven't texted me - supportive in the press. It's fine. It's not the end anyway. I'm not calling for any support from any drivers or whatever. That's not what I need. It's a difficult world for everybody in a way.
"We are all living in that same thing. If you don't perform for three races, you are the worst. If you perform in three good races, you are the best. So, that's the difficulty of the sport."
